title: The overflow menu holds Download (CSV), Download (PDF) and Print in that order, with no separate export buttons
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report.
steps: 1. Find the overflow menu in the toolbar's action area and note its position.
2. Open it and read the items in order.
3. Look around the toolbar for any separate always-visible export buttons.
expected: 1. The overflow (export) menu is the leftmost control in the toolbar's action area and is the application's standard overflow-menu control.
2. The menu items read, in order: "Download (CSV)", "Download (PDF)", "Print" (Print is the third item).
3. There are no separate always-visible export buttons — all exports live behind this one menu.
